application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
G1	Hazel (Corylus avellana)	In cottage garden - Coppice 2 x Hazel at ground level. Final height = 0.2m and final spread = 0.3m

T2	Bay (Laurus nobilis)	Front garden - cut back hard to the boundary where overhanging fountain and flat roof. Trim/reduce to round off and shape remaining crown. Final height unchanged = 4m and final spread = 3m	

T3	Magnolia grandiflora	Rear of house - Reduce height down to similar height as top gutter. Reduce remaining crown to shape. Final height = 5m and final spread = 4m

T5	Cherry Laurel (Prunus laurocerasus)	Front of house - Reduce height by around 50%, reduce spread by around 1m. Remove low growing stems at base of adjacent yew. Final height = 3m and final spread = 2m

T6	Holly (Ilex aquifolium)	Front of house - Reduce height to similar height as reduced laurel. Final height = 3m and final spread = 2m	

T7	Common Lime (Tilia x europaea)	Re-Pollard back to previous pollard points removing approximately 2-2.5m of new growth. Final height 7m and spread 5m.	

T8	Holly (Ilex aquifolium)	Front of house - Reduce height of crown by 50%, reduce spread to shape. Final height = 4m and final spread = 3m	

T9	Holly (Ilex aquifolium)	Front of house - remove stem closest to road. Final height unchanged = 4m and final spread = 3m
